findings.title: Require admin authorization for the bulk export handler
findings.comment: Reproduced with tok-ana: /exports/all returns 200 including globex/private's secret, while /admin/tenants returns 403 and /exports/private returns 404. /tmp/native-review-smoke/case3/app.py routes the fixed bulk path directly to an @authenticated handler that reads every tenant without checking the role. The README explicitly requires admin access.

findings.title: Return the persisted revision instead of the row count
findings.comment: Reproduced a three-row creation returning revision 3 and ETag W/"3" although the persisted revision is 1; the next conditional PUT using 3 fails with 409 without an intervening write. /tmp/native-review-smoke/case3/app.py uses save_document's return as the revision, but /tmp/native-review-smoke/case3/store.py explicitly documents its new row-count return and instructs callers to load the revision. Equal-row-count saves also necessarily produce unchanged response ETags.

findings.title: Use an exclusive slice endpoint for pagination
findings.comment: Verified /tmp/native-review-smoke/case3/app.py slices names[first:last + 1] with last = first + limit. Reproduced names a,b,c with limit=1: pages 1 and 2 return [a,b] and [b,c]. Also reproduced 201 entries for limit=200. The extra endpoint violates page size and overlaps consecutive pages.

Check fixed-versus-variable route precedence in /tmp/native-review-smoke/case3/app.py. Focus on reserved `/exports/all` behavior and access to a document named `all`.
